body_html:
A great night for a wedding, at the Hudson Gardens. The Bride and Groom looked great, and so did their venue. We had an incredible violinist hook into our system to play the background music for the wedding itself. The reception went over incredibly well too! Everybody was dancing to oldies, all night long! Another great event with Jammin’ DJ’s.’

DJ Dillon
